human_authorization.verbatim: Faca o que precisa para finalizar o 1340 ou precisa de outro passo?
human_authorization.interpretation: Autoriza concluir as obrigacoes ainda declaradas no Passo 1340. Nao autoriza por implicacao contrato publico novo, mudanca de fase, default ou compatibilidade; qualquer necessidade dessas classes para no gate ADR-0127.

decision.reason: R4/lifecycle, NT01-NT06 e gates finais ja pertencem ao objetivo e as obrigacoes de conclusao do Passo 1340. A cadeia R6 reabre somente esse fragmento inacabado.

scope: Seal an executable successor for the unfinished R4 lifecycle/profile contract
Bind real Func invocation identity and causal source edges without inventing them
Bind real counter-event occurrence and lexical origin where the source still exists
Execute inherited public/lifecycle matrices, terminal attacks NT01-NT06 and applicable mutations
Run final build, focused and regression tests, V15/V26, lint and independent verdict
preserved: Terminal R5 sources, expectations, seal and candidate verdict
Approved terminal policy and exact terminal diagnostic
All historical contracts, receipts, baselines and failed witnesses
Normal APIs, public entities, product defaults, pipeline phases and compatibility
Unknown never counts as Preserved except in fixtures explicitly authored to test opacity

root.may_read: all repository inputs needed after seal
root.may_write: new authority/baseline/report artifacts and candidate implementation within already-approved P1340 L0
root.must_not: edit sealed contract, oracle, attacks or issue own final verdict

contract_author_r6.may_read: current L0, R4 documentary contract, R4 interface inventory, historical protected contracts and verifier findings
contract_author_r6.may_write: new p1340-contract-*-r6 and oracle artifacts only
contract_author_r6.must_not: read candidate production sources, candidate adapter, implementation receipts or candidate output

adversary_r6.may_read: authority, L0, baseline metadata and R6 contract after publication

verifier_r6.may_read: authority, protected inputs, frozen R6 contract/oracles/attacks and candidate outputs
verifier_r6.may_write: new p1340-verifier-*-r6 receipts, seal and verdict only
verifier_r6.must_not: modify contract, attacks, candidate or reports being judged

stop_conditions: A public API/entity/default/phase/compatibility change is required
The same classification vector and cause survives two revisions
Required provenance is absent from all allowed real callsites
A valid negative mutation survives or a mandatory observation is Unknown
